content.what_it_is: MATLAB function k=wvnum_omvec(h,omega,g) @L1 (spectral_data copy used by Step_2_IG_wave.m; byte-identical to the 2_wave_components copy, same SHA-256): solves the linear dispersion relation omega^2=g*k*tanh(k*h) for wavenumber k, vectorized over omega. Initial guess k=(omega^2/g)/sqrt(tanh(omega^2*h/g)) @L3 (Eckart-type approximation); then Newton-Raphson iteration (comment @L5) until all relative changes are below 1e-6: residual f=omega.^2-g*k.*tanh(k*h) @L9, derivative fp=-g*tanh(k*h)-g*(k*h)./cosh(k*h).^2 @L10, update kn=k-f./fp @L11, error=abs(kn-k)./k @L12, k=kn @L13.
entities: function k=wvnum_omvec(h,omega,g) @L1; locals: error @L7 (init ones(length(h),1)'), f @L9, fp @L10, kn @L11
calls: intrinsics only: tanh @L3/L9/L10, sqrt @L3, cosh @L10, ones @L7, any/abs in while condition @L8
unresolved: error is initialized with ones(length(h),1)' @L7 — sized by scalar h (length 1), not by the omega vector; the while condition still works because error is re-assigned @L12 to omega's shape after the first iteration, but the first-pass condition tests a single 1
The local variable name 'error' shadows MATLAB's built-in error function inside this scope

No iteration cap: the while loop @L8-L15 runs until convergence with tolerance .000001 on relative change — divergence (e.g. omega=0) would loop forever; f/fp sign convention: kn=k-f./fp @L11 with fp defined as the negative derivative of f w.r.t. k means the update is k+f/|fp'| — consistent as written since fp = -d(residual)/dk
